create_gaudi_generation_config: create a GaudiGenerationConfig instance with HPU-specific generation parameters like static_shapes and ignore_eos
configure_flash_attention: configure flash attention settings including recompute, causal mask, and fast softmax for HPU generation
set_static_shapes: set static_shapes and bucket_size on GaudiGenerationConfig to optimize HPU generation performance
configure_batch_split: configure attn_batch_split and decode_attn_batch_split on GaudiGenerationConfig for attention and MLP layer splitting
tune_hpu_memory: tune HPU memory usage by setting trim_logits, reuse_cache, and limit_hpu_graphs on GaudiGenerationConfig
